## Description

Briefly describe the change and motivation behind it.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking enhancement)
- [ ] Security hardening or secret scrubbing
- [ ] Performance optimization
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Knowledge base rule update (rebuilt via `make build-kb`)

## Validation

- [ ] Python syntax validation passed (`make lint`)
- [ ] Full test suite passed (`make test`)
- [ ] Micro-benchmark demonstration passed (`make demo`)
- [ ] Tested on macOS / Linux

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the established coding style of this project
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, etc.)
- [ ] No private credentials, tokens, or environment artifacts are committed
